nodes.label: AMPM Platform Design Package (docs/README.md index)
nodes.rationale: Drafts v0.2, 25 Oct 2026. AMPM answered all 25 questions on 25 Oct; answers are applied to every draft and stamped on every assumption; eleven points remain to confirm; nothing is signed off. Part A is written for AMPM with no technical background; Part B is the developer drafts behind it.

nodes.label: Part A: documents for AMPM to review and decide (A1 to A6)
nodes.rationale: Reading order: guide, decision brief, annotated brief, redrawn flowcharts, open decisions (answer the ten Tier 1 questions first), assumptions taken (tick or correct each line).

nodes.label: Part B: developer drafts for reference (B0 to B9)
A2 Decision brief (review/decision-brief.md)
nodes.rationale: The short version with AMPM's answers under every question and the eleven points still to confirm; also published alone as site/brief.html.

nodes.label: A3 Your brief, annotated (review/annotated-brief.md)
nodes.rationale: AMPM's five documents reproduced in full with every audit finding placed at the passage it concerns.

nodes.label: A4 Your flowcharts, redrawn (review/redesigned-flowcharts.md)
nodes.rationale: The two flowcharts and the customer journey as supplied and as upgraded, additions in green and changes in amber.

nodes.label: A5 Decisions we need from you (review/open-decisions.md)
nodes.rationale: The 25 questions in plain language with choices, the assumption taken, and an answer box.

nodes.label: A6 Assumptions we took (review/assumptions-taken.md, generated)
nodes.rationale: Every assumption made in place of an answer, grouped by theme, with a confirm column; generated by assumptions_sheet_build.py and excluded from the graph by .graphifyignore.

nodes.label: B0 decision-log.md (generated)
nodes.rationale: AMPM's answer to every question, what it does to each assumption, and the items still to confirm; rebuilt by decision_log_build.py.

nodes.label: B1 requirements-audit.md
nodes.rationale: The audit of the brief: 9 conflicts, 44 gaps, 15 ambiguities, 8 risks, 25 decisions (Q1 to Q25 in section 11; CF, GP, AM, RK findings in sections 4 to 10).

nodes.label: B2 decision-register.md (generated)
nodes.rationale: Every assumption indexed by the question it depends on; rebuilt by decision_register_build.py; excluded from the graph by .graphifyignore.

nodes.label: B3 user-flows.md
nodes.rationale: Twelve end-to-end flows U-1 to U-12 with statuses, notifications and screens.

nodes.label: B4 wireframes.md
nodes.rationale: Screen-by-screen specification, 124 screens, with sketches; defines the PUB, AUTH, DM, CP, TW and GR identifiers.

nodes.label: B5 data-model.md
nodes.rationale: Entity-relationship model, 106 tables in 17 Mermaid diagrams; source of field-matrix.md.

nodes.label: B6 permission-matrix.md
nodes.rationale: Roles, entitlements, visibility classes, transitions, audited actions.

nodes.label: B7 field-matrix.md and field-matrix.csv (generated)
nodes.rationale: Every field: type, validation, editor, visibility, when required, automation; rebuilt by field_matrix_build.py from data-model.md and field_rules.py; excluded from the graph by .graphifyignore.

nodes.label: B8 architecture.md
nodes.rationale: Technology, hosting, security, backups, maintenance, integration plan (T-1 to T-14).

nodes.label: B9 test-cases.md
nodes.rationale: 36 acceptance criteria, 208 tests (AC-nn.m), phase exit packs, test data.

nodes.label: Milestone schedule and cost estimate (not yet drafted)
nodes.rationale: Held until the platform (Q1) and volume (Q15) questions are answered; README.md says schedule and estimate wait for the eleven remaining points.

nodes.label: Identifier scheme of the design package
nodes.rationale: Q1 to Q25: decisions only AMPM can make. CF, GP, AM, RK: audit findings (conflict, gap, ambiguity, risk). A, P, T, U, W, V: assumptions made in place of an answer for data model, permissions, technology, flows, screens, testing, each in section 0 of its developer draft. PUB, AUTH, DM, CP, TW, GR: screens. AC-nn.m: test cases. Propagation rule: when AMPM answers a question, the assumption lines that cite it are confirmed or replaced, then the tables, screens and tests that cite those lines, then the generated files are rebuilt.

nodes.label: field_matrix_build.py (generator)
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds field-matrix.md and field-matrix.csv from the diagrams in data-model.md and the rules in field_rules.py; generated files must not be edited by hand.

nodes.label: field_rules.py (field rules for the field matrix)
decision_register_build.py (generator)
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds decision-register.md from the assumption registers and the audit's question list.

nodes.label: assumptions_sheet_build.py (generator)
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds review/assumptions-taken.md from the assumption registers, grouped by theme.

nodes.label: apply_decisions.py (stamps decisions onto assumption registers)
nodes.rationale: Stamps AMPM's decisions from decisions.json on every assumption register (section 0 of each developer draft); run with decision_log_build.py whenever decisions.json changes, then the three other generators.

nodes.label: decision_log_build.py (generator)
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds decision-log.md after apply_decisions.py.

nodes.label: docs/decisions.json (AMPM's recorded decisions)
nodes.rationale: Edited when AMPM confirms a remaining point; the input to apply_decisions.py and decision_log_build.py.

nodes.label: site_build.mjs (renders the package as one shareable page)
nodes.rationale: Rebuilds site/index.html, the whole package as one page; --brief rebuilds site/brief.html, the decision brief alone; needs the marked package installed with npm install inside docs/tools.

nodes.label: site/index.html (whole package rendered as one page)
Published review package artifact for AMPM (claude.ai/artifact/55fJPFQnnqi8sVVU7FUFcv)
nodes.rationale: The private claude.ai artifact AMPM reads; republished after every site_build.mjs rebuild so the link stays the same.

nodes.label: AMPM source documents in reference_docs/ (BIZ, WHY, SPEC, TEAM-FLOW, PORTAL-FLOW)
nodes.rationale: The brief AMPM supplied: the business explanation (BIZ), the Why AMPM App note (WHY), the Developer Technical Specification v1.0 (SPEC), and two Level-1 flowcharts (TEAM-FLOW, PORTAL-FLOW); the drafts cite them by these codes.

nodes.label: GitHub repository app-ampm/ampm-platform
nodes.rationale: Private; holds the design package, the audit, AMPM's source documents, the generators, and later the code.

nodes.label: GitHub repository app-ampm/ampm-vault
nodes.rationale: Private; checked out at vault/ (ignored by the project repository); holds the Obsidian vault: generated notes, a synced copy of docs/, a copy of reference_docs/, the Obsidian configuration.

nodes.label: GitHub account app-ampm (project identity)
nodes.rationale: Both repositories carry their own git identity (the app-ampm address) so nothing committed in these folders is recorded under another account; both automation scripts refuse to commit if a repository has no identity of its own.

nodes.label: git-credential-ampm.sh (account-bound credential helper)
nodes.rationale: Takes the app-ampm account's token from the GitHub CLI keyring whichever gh account is active.

nodes.label: setup_git.sh (restores identity, credential helper, post-commit hook, vault clone)
nodes.rationale: Run after cloning: restores the per-repo identity, the credential helper, the post-commit hook and the vault clone.

nodes.label: Obsidian vault (vault/)
nodes.rationale: Home.md is the hub; notes/ holds one note per question with AMPM's decision, one per assumption with status, one per audit finding, one per open item, and a log. docs/ and reference_docs/ are synced copies: edit documents in the project, not in the vault, because the next sync overwrites the copy. Notes written in Obsidian (open items, log, own notes) are kept and committed. The vault is the human-readable record; the palace and the graph are what a session reads.

nodes.label: checkpoint.sh (commit, push, then sync the vault)
nodes.rationale: Run by the Stop hook with --hook: commits and pushes the project if anything changed, then syncs the vault; prints a one-line message only when it committed. By hand: bash docs/tools/checkpoint.sh "message". Logs to ~/Library/Logs/ampm-vault-sync.log.

nodes.label: vault_sync.py (copies docs into the vault, rebuilds notes, commits and pushes the vault)
nodes.rationale: Run by the post-commit hook; copies docs/ and reference_docs/ into the vault, rebuilds the generated notes, appends to the day's sync log note, commits and pushes the vault when something changed. --vault-only (launchd timer) commits and pushes edits made inside Obsidian.

nodes.label: memory_hook.sh (session memory hooks)
nodes.rationale: session-start tells the session what the memory wing and the knowledge graph hold and whether the graph is stale; on Stop, PreCompact and SessionEnd it mines the session transcript into the MemPalace wing ampm in the background. Logs to ~/Library/Logs/ampm-memory-hooks.log.

nodes.label: setup_memory.sh (installs MemPalace and graphify on a new machine)
nodes.rationale: Installs the two CLIs at the tested versions with uv tool install and backfills the wing with the project's transcripts and docs.

nodes.label: launchd agent com.ampm.vault-sync (ten-minute vault timer)
nodes.rationale: Every ten minutes runs vault_sync.py --vault-only; definition in docs/tools/; stop with launchctl bootout gui/$(id -u)/com.ampm.vault-sync.

nodes.label: Claude Code Stop hook (.claude/settings.json)
nodes.rationale: End of every Claude Code turn in this folder runs checkpoint.sh --hook and memory_hook.sh.

nodes.label: Git post-commit hook (installed by setup_git.sh)
nodes.rationale: Every project commit runs vault_sync.py; commits made by the checkpoint also run mempalace mine docs --wing ampm.

nodes.label: Claude Code SessionStart hook
nodes.rationale: Runs memory_hook.sh session-start.

nodes.label: PreToolUse hook: graphify hook-guard
nodes.rationale: Installed by graphify install --project; before every search or file read points the session at the knowledge graph instead of grepping when the graph can answer.

nodes.label: MemPalace 3.11 (session memory, wing ampm)
nodes.rationale: Local palace in ~/.mempalace, wing ampm: the transcript of every session run in this folder or its worktrees, and the design docs; verbatim text, semantic search, no API calls. Use mempalace search "<words>" --wing ampm, mempalace wake-up --wing ampm; MCP server mempalace (palace_query, palace_exec). The palace itself is not committed.

nodes.label: graphify 0.9 (knowledge-graph tool)
nodes.rationale: /graphify . builds or rebuilds, /graphify . --update refreshes changed files; graphify query, explain, path; graphify-out/graph.html; MCP server graphify. Committed wiring: .claude/settings.json hooks, .mcp.json, .claude/skills/graphify/, .graphifyignore, CLAUDE.md, graphify-out/.

nodes.label: Knowledge graph of the design package (graphify-out/)
nodes.rationale: Concepts, screens, flows, decisions and the edges between them, each tagged extracted or inferred; the graph, report, extraction cache and manifest are committed so a fresh worktree queries the same graph without rebuilding. Independent of the vault.

nodes.label: Procedure: recording a confirmation from AMPM
nodes.rationale: Open-item and log notes are written once and kept, so: record the confirmation in the open item's note (status: confirmed), update docs/decisions.json, run apply_decisions.py, decision_log_build.py, decision_register_build.py, assumptions_sheet_build.py, vault_build.py and site_build.mjs (with --brief too), republish the two shared pages; the next checkpoint commits everything and the vault follows.
